market_assumption: RB/AG/AU single-contract daily bars; public Sina data
signal_time: trade-date t close; enter same contract at t+1 open, exit t+1 close
contract_selection: highest volume at signal-date close within fixed contract universe
delivery_buffer: entry date before delivery month starts minus 30 calendar days
entry_gate: train-only product-specific 70th percentile of absolute factor; nonzero factor
position: sign(factor); three product sleeves each 1/3 fixed notional; missing sleeve stays cash
selection: highest train 5bps net Sharpe among positive rankIC, positive mean net, at least 100 trades; tie by factor id
validation_gate: selected candidate positive validation rankIC, positive mean net, at least 50 trades
holdout_gate: same as validation; evaluated once only if validation passed
stopping_rule: finish round 1; if validation fails stop this batch, keep holdout sealed; further rounds require new training-only hypotheses and log, never reuse an opened holdout
notes: No direction flipping, no optimized lookbacks/costs, no leveraged/margin equity return. Daily OHLC is not evidence of post-open fill feasibility.
